findings.passage: Clerks have been asking for changes to elections for years, but instead of listening to the nonpartisan experts and enacting the needed changes, Republicans have put forth a package of bills that makes it harder to vote, and harder to run elections. I stand today on the side of Wisconsin voters, non-partisan clerks, and democracy, and I oppose these bills.
